intent: A tiny wrapper that crossfades one child to the next when its key changes, for value and state swaps (a status chip going Running → Done, a thumbnail, a chart). A motion primitive, not a Card.
useWhen: a status, value or thumbnail swaps in place and a hard cut would feel jumpy
announce the new value politely to screen readers while it swaps
doNotUseWhen: showing and hiding a panel — Collapsible or Accordion

children.note: The current value. Any child: Badge, image, chart.

contentKey.note: Changing it triggers the swap. The outgoing layer shows the content as it was when that key arrived.

duration.note: fast = motion.duration200 (Paper's motion.fast); normal = motion.duration300. No raw ms.

label.note: Sent to an aria-live=polite region when the content swaps, e.g. "Status: Done".

motion.exit: opacity 1 → 0, blur 0 → 6px, overlapped with the enter
motion.exception: filter: blur is the one approved exception to the kit's transform/opacity-only rule (Boris, 2026-11-10): max 6px, only on the two crossfade layers, never under reduced motion.
motion.reducedMotion: no blur: the old value goes at once; the new one fades in over motion.duration100

requirements: the outgoing layer is aria-hidden and inert
label, when set, is announced through aria-live=polite

doNot: Do not copy its blur into other components; the filter exception is for BlurCrossfade only
Do not wrap long or interactive regions; it is for small values
Do not pass raw ms; pick a duration token
